_comment: P0 containment (T03). This registry is INTENTIONALLY EMPTY. No approvals or reviewers are seeded by engineering or agent work. Both lists are populated ONLY out-of-band by the customer's authorized legal lead. authorized_reviewers entries: {reviewer_id, name, status: 'active', revoked_at: null, added_at}. An approval counts only if its reviewer_id matches an active, unrevoked authorized_reviewers entry; app user roles, verified_by/reviewed_by fields, ADMIN_KEY and seed timestamps never confer approval. Approval entries need their own reviewer_id, an exact content_hash of the specific text version being approved, and status 'active'. A text change invalidates the hash and the approval fails closed automatically. Set status to 'revoked' (and revoked_at) to withdraw an approval or a reviewer; never delete the historical record.
